Example 2 at an illustrative 3.70 NIS (3.70 ₪) per USD with green score 120: 117,991 NIS (117,991 ₪) tax, 101% of CIF. Amounts in ₪: 100000 ₪, 104000 ₪, 159000 ₪, 36500 ₪, 36523 ₪, 14523 ₪, 22000 ₪, 8690 ₪, 2400 ₪, 300000 ₪. Rates 83% and 48% per the Customs Book. At 110,000 NIS the total is about 77% of value; with the ITA guide 19,498 NIS EV row the threshold would be about 118,600 NIS. Japan-built Example 2 (--origin other): 116% of CIF, landed about $69,400.
